title: Current Step Context Inspector
phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI

candidateSource.candidatePurpose: Let the Operator see the durable-state evidence behind the routed current action.
candidateSource.candidateSummary: Map a context inspector that shows current project/phase state, relevant artifact paths, missing records, stale/superseded artifacts, MCP/write availability, and why the current step is available or blocked.

purpose: Let the Operator inspect why the app selected the current required action without adding another permanent, duplicative workspace surface.
humanProblem: The Operator needs to understand why ChampCity A/I believes the current action is correct, but the UI must not reintroduce the duplicated panes and context surfaces repaired in WC07-REPAIR01.

carriedForwardObservationsIncluded.title: Top workflow/action bars and Supporting Tools are duplicative and consume workspace real estate
carriedForwardObservationsIncluded.reasonIncluded: WC08 risks adding another context surface. The inspector must avoid worsening top-level navigation clutter and must not add another always-visible pane or duplicate Supporting Tools/action-bar information.
carriedForwardObservationsIncluded.acceptanceImpact: WC08 must provide context through a collapsible, tabbed, or otherwise subordinate inspector; it must not add persistent workspace clutter.

openObservationsReviewedButNotIncluded.title: Validation checklist should become editable / structured
openObservationsReviewedButNotIncluded.dispositionForWC08: Not in scope; belongs to WC12 or later validation-record workflow work.

openObservationsReviewedButNotIncluded.title: Screenshot paste and evidence UI needs cleanup
openObservationsReviewedButNotIncluded.dispositionForWC08: Not in scope; belongs to WC12 or later validation evidence UX work.

openObservationsReviewedButNotIncluded.title: Multi-project / workspace support does not exist
openObservationsReviewedButNotIncluded.dispositionForWC08: Not in scope; belongs to a future project/workspace management phase.

requiredDesignModel.leftPanelOwnership: Left panel remains compact current-action summary only and must not regain source-evidence, missing-evidence, route-outcome, warning, or raw-path stacks.
requiredDesignModel.centerWorkspaceOwnership: Center workspace owns current work and artifact review. The context inspector may be tabbed, collapsible, or dismissible, but must not compete with artifacts or the current-action form.
requiredDesignModel.supportingScreenMode: Supporting/reference screens must not render the full current-step context inspector as their own content.

requiredFunctionalBehavior: Provide readable route explanation from current required action model.
Show durable project, phase, Work Card, Implementer Report, Architect Review, validation, repair, closeout, roadmap, and next-phase state categories when available.
Explain missing records with type, reason, and secondary/collapsed path detail.
Surface stale, superseded, malformed, unreadable, and warning evidence in plain language before technical detail.
Expose app read/write or capability state only when available; otherwise state that it is not reported by current app state.
Keep the inspector read-only and non-mutating.
Preserve artifact-review and current-action form usability.
acceptanceCriteria: A current-action context inspector is available from the routed current-action workspace.
The inspector explains why the current action was selected using human-readable labels.
The inspector shows project, phase, Work Card, report, review, validation, and repair state categories when available.
Missing records are explained with type, reason, and secondary/collapsed path detail.
Warnings are grouped by severity and use plain-language wording before technical detail.
Stale/superseded/historical records are not presented as controlling workflow authority.
Read/write or app capability state is shown only when available; otherwise the UI says it is not reported.
The inspector is read-only and does not mutate workflow state.
The inspector does not add another always-visible pane competing with the workspace.
The left panel remains compact and does not regain artifact/source/missing/warning stacks.
Supporting/reference screens do not render the full context inspector as if it were their own content.
WC07 artifact review remains the owner of artifact browsing/preview.
Artifacts and Complete current action remain easy to reach.
WC04, WC05, WC06, and WC07-REPAIR01 behavior remains preserved.
validationExpectations: Read AGENTS.md and docs/dev/VALIDATION_COMMAND_LANES.md before validation.
Run the approved normal Windows validation lane.
Run current-action-only fixture validation if affected.
Run WC04/WC05/WC06/WC07 focused fixtures if affected.
Add or update a focused WC08 fixture verifying layout ownership, read-only behavior, warning/missing record presentation, and non-duplication of WC07 artifact review.
Run local safety scans before staging.
outOfScope: full Supporting Tools redesign unless narrowly required to prevent WC08 duplication
provider SDKs, database, cloud services, authentication, MCP integration, connector behavior, deployment, release, or packaging changes
